context.body: The night remembered in later Scripture
context.label: Event location

observations.body: Levites are taken from among Israel in place of all firstborn who open the womb.
observations.label: Exchange

observations.body: The LORD’s claim is tied directly to the day Egypt’s firstborn were struck.
observations.label: Grounding day

observations.body: “They shall be mine” and “all the firstborn are mine” frame the explanation.
observations.label: Repeated claim

payload.posture: Stay with this witness’s people, objects, speech, sequence, and stated connections before moving to another account or later use.
payload.tension: A past act in Egypt becomes the stated basis for a continuing relationship between the LORD, Israel’s firstborn, and the Levites.
payload.title: The Levites are taken in place of Israel’s firstborn
